title: ZuCo 1.0: Simultaneous EEG and Eye-Tracking during Natural Reading
description: ZuCo 1.0 is a BIDS-formatted dataset of simultaneous 128-channel EEG and eye-tracking recorded while adult native English speakers read natural sentences. Three reading tasks are included: sentiment reading of movie-review sentences, normal reading of Wikipedia sentences, and task-specific reading with semantic relation annotation. The dataset supports research on the neural and oculomotor correlates of natural language comprehension.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 128-channel EGI Geodesic system at 500 Hz with a Cz reference. Eye movements were recorded simultaneously from the left eye with an EyeLink 1000 at 500 Hz. Each reading block is stored as a run. Gaze and pupil samples are stored as physio data, and fixations, saccades and blinks are stored in events.tsv.
